sam_sales: Quick handoff for Helix Health — signed enterprise, target go-live in 3 weeks. Main asks: SSO (Okta), private VPC deploy, and a ramp plan for 50k monthly tokens. Renewal cliff in 11 months, initial ARR $120k. I’m tagging CS to own onboarding and ENG for SSO work. Link to signed SOW: https://redwood.co/sow/HLX-2026-01 :point_up:

maria_cs: Thanks Sam — taking ownership. Quick questions: do they need dedicated capacity or hosted with VPC peering? Any compliance controls we should pre-provide?

sam_sales: They asked for private deployment (VPC) + dedicated capacity for burst windows. Compliance: SOC2 + data residency (EU). Contact at Helix: emma@helix.example, phone +44 20 5555 1212. Provisioning window is week of Apr 5.

maria_cs: Got it. I’ll set the onboarding runbook and schedule kickoff. Initial owners: Maria (CS) — onboarding lead, Lee (Support/Eng) — SSO & infra, Anika (Customer Success Ops) — renewal & enablement play.

maria_cs: Action items I’ll own this week:
• Create onboarding workspace and share docs with Helix.
• Set up initial success plan and milestones (prod by Apr 25).
• Prep enablement session for their ML infra team (1h).

lee_support: I can take SSO/VPC tasks. I’ll need the Okta org metadata from Helix and their VPC CIDR ranges. Creating ticket now and will attach checklist.

lee_support: /ticket create --team=infra --priority=P2 --desc="Helix Okta metadata + VPC peering for private deploy" --owner=lee_support

reminder-bot: Meeting scheduled: Helix Kickoff — Apr 6 10:00 UTC (maria_cs, lee_support, anika_success, sam_sales). Invite sent.

anika_success: I’ll own renewal risk tracking and enablement. Notes:
• Renewal cliff 11 months — flag for quarterly business reviews starting month 6.
• Capture success metrics: latency SLO, monthly cost target, feature adoption (chat + embeddings).
• I’ll build the feedback capture template for post-kickoff (short form + 3-week check-in).

maria_cs: Small blocker: Helix has internal network change freeze Apr 10–14. We should aim to finish VPC peering before the freeze or schedule maintenance window.

sam_sales: They confirmed we can do peering Apr 7–9. OK to proceed.

lee_support: Noted. I’ll prioritize peering configuration Apr 7 and keep a rollback plan. I’ll post the config snippet when ready.

lee_support: Config checklist (preview):
```
- Collect Okta metadata XML
- Exchange VPC CIDRs (Helix / Redwood-proxy)
- Setup peering and route tables
- Test private endpoint connectivity
- Verify KV-cache encryption at rest
```

maria_cs: Two next steps for CS: 1) run a 30-min internal pre-kickoff with Helix docs + SOW review (maria_cs + anika_success + sam_sales), 2) invite product enablement for training (2 weeks before go-live).

anika_success: I’ll draft the pre-kickoff agenda and send to Sam for approval by EOD. Also adding a feedback poll to measure their enablement readiness.

sam_sales: Approve agenda draft once posted. Also flagged legal for data residency appendix — they’ll send standard addendum.

lee_support: Creating ENG ticket: INF-7842. I’ll link to the onboarding workspace and update with network artifacts. Tag me if you need a test account for validation.

maria_cs: Thanks Lee — can you also share the expected downtime window for peering changes so I can inform Helix ops?

lee_support: Expect <15min downtime during BGP propagation; will attempt during low traffic. I’ll include that in INF-7842.

sam_sales: One more item: Helix requested a short product roadmap summary for the features they signed up for (real-time recall + embeddings). Can CS provide that in the kickoff pack?

maria_cs: Yes — I’ll attach a 1-page feature roadmap and an onboarding checklist to the kickoff invite.

anika_success: Capturing feedback ask: please have Helix rank the importance of latency vs cost vs feature parity in the kickoff form. This will feed Optimize recommendations.

sam_sales: Great. If anything blocks before Apr 6 ping me. :thumbsup:

maria_cs: Taking next steps now. I’ll post the workspace link and runbook items in this thread once created. :white_check_mark:

lee_support: I’ll update INF-7842 with the final peering plan and post a short runbook snippet here when complete.

reminder-bot: Reminder: Pre-kickoff internal sync in 24 hours.

maria_cs: Internal pre-kickoff done — workspace up: https://redwood.co/onboard/hlx-workspace. Putting owners on tasks. Will follow up after the customer kickoff. :rocket:
